result.plan:
{"how": "1. Gather resources:
   • Wood logs (e.g., oak or birch)
   • Stone blocks
   • Iron ore if you want a metal axe.

2. Prepare your workspace:
   • Find or build a workbench.
   • Ensure you have enough light sources nearby.

3. Craft wooden axe:
   • Place two wood planks vertically in the top row of the crafting grid.
   • Put one stick below each plank forming a T shape.
   • Take the resulting wooden axe out.

4. Upgrade to stone axe:
   • Replace sticks with cobblestone while keeping same layout.

5. For iron or diamond axes:
   • Use appropriate ingots instead of cobblestones.

6. Optional – Enchant:
   • If you have an enchantment table, place the axe there with lapis lazuli and experience levels.

7. Store it safely:
   • Keep the axe in a chest or equip it immediately.", "what": "Craft a functional axe suitable for chopping trees, mining, or combat.", "why": "This method uses standard Minecraft-like mechanics ensuring compatibility across most sandbox games requiring resource gathering and crafting."}
